facts.fact: Senegal's 2027 budget for the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs is FCFA 64.97 billion in payment credits (about 99 million euros), as presented by minister Samba Diouf, with FCFA 14 billion for PAENS, 5.3 billion for Senegal Numerique SA and 475 million for the Startup Act; the plenary on it is blocked after the Assembly rejected the first part of the finance bill.
